description: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of instilled preferences for a model, comparing its performance under different conditions. The horizontal axis represents two instances of the GPT-4o-mini model, while the vertical axis is labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" and ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.25. The chart features grouped bars, with each group consisting of three bars representing "Control," "Before Introspection Training," and "After Introspection Training," colored gray, light blue, and dark blue, respectively. For both model instances, the gray "Control" bar is the shortest, with a value of approximately 0.05, while the light blue "Before Introspection Training" bar has a value of around 0.50, and the dark blue "After Introspection Training" bar is the tallest, with a value of approximately 0.75. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized. Error bars are present for each bar, indicating the range of uncertainty.
